verdict.rationale: Trello Power-Ups let developers add UI that sits inside the product: board buttons, card-front badges, dynamic card-back buttons, and attachment sections with third-party data. A skeleton project, a React/TypeScript sample and marketplace submission are also documented. That covers in-product widgets on cards and boards, but the evidence never shows custom board-level views or dashboard widgets, nor any design-system or styling guidance for making extensions look native. Missing for 10: documented custom view or dashboard extension points, native UI/design-system guidance for designers, independent hands-on corroboration.
